# Mr. Electric

> Mr. Electric provides comprehensive commercial and residential electrical services including repairs, installations, emergency support, and safety upgrades across multiple states.

Mr. Electric is part of the Neighborly family of home service companies and specializes in residential and commercial electrical work, from routine outlet installations to complex panel upgrades and EV charger setups. The company emphasizes safety compliance, 24/7 emergency service, and customer financing options.

## Key Topics

- Electrical safety
- Residential electrical services
- GFCI outlets
- Outlet installation and replacement
- Electrical panel upgrades
- EV charger installation
- Circuit breaker replacement
- Surge protection
- Emergency electrical repair
- 240-volt outlets
- Smart home electrical solutions
- National Electrical Code (NEC)
- Tamper-resistant outlets
- 24/7 service availability
- Neighborly Done Right Promise
